title: QUBIQ: Uncertainty Quantification for Biomedical Image Segmentation Challenge
mechanism: A challenge that scores predictions against the distribution of several raters (soft-label scoring over thresholds).
adaptation: Where two label versions exist, the crack test score uses their distribution, so methods are not ranked on one annotator's 1-2 px trace.
min_experiment: On cells with two versions, compute soft-threshold Dice for house vs PF vs ensemble. Decision: adopt it if the ranking differs from strict IoU on the revised labels.
evidence: R: multi-rater biomedical challenge across several tasks (abstract level).
